caption: Soil carbon stock by lake, year and season. Small points are site values; lines show means and bars show sample SD across five sites. Equal site weighting; repeated sites across seasons. Source: Scatter Plot.xlsx. Unit: Mg C per hectare.

Phytoplankton carbon by lake, year and season. Small points are site values; lines show means and bars show sample SD across five sites. Equal site weighting; repeated sites across seasons. Source: Scatter Plot.xlsx. Phytoplankton-carbon unit is not supplied.

Reported TBC means from Scatter Plot.xlsx, Line_Graph. The monsoon mean is highest in both lakes and years. Units and the meaning of the supplied +/- values are unconfirmed, so no error bars are drawn. The TBC-labelled raw block duplicates TDS and is excluded.

Soil carbon stock versus Soil temperature. Panels separate lakes; seasons use different symbols. Both years are included (40 records per lake). X limits are shared, but y limits are lake-specific; apparent slopes should not be compared across panels. Numeric values are unaltered. Environmental units are not supplied.
